title: Grateful Dead Live at Carousel Ballroom on 1968-03-16
lineage: SBD > MR > C > DAT > CDR > EAC (secure) > Cool Edit (minor fixes) > CD Wave (retracking) > mkwACT > SHN (seekable)

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of a high‑energy March 16 1968 show with smoking Alligator, sublime Caution→Feedback and a standout Eleven, despite occasional tape cuts and muddy bass.
ai_review.review: The performance is a quintessential ’68 experience – the band rides intense jams on Alligator, The Eleven and Caution > Feedback, with Jerry’s guitar soaring and Phil laying down heavy bass. The soundboard source is generally listenable but suffers from frequent cuts, hiss and an over‑emphasized low end that detracts from an otherwise excellent tape.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rave about the musical energy and key jams, while noting consistent technical issues (cuts, mud) that keep the recording from being excellent; the weighted average yields a strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear for a 1968 soundboard but plagued by tape cuts (Cryptical, Alligator intro), occasional drop‑outs, heavy bass/muddy mids and some hiss; still listenable for fans of the era.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Jam‑heavy set with strong transitions; some confusion over track ordering but overall a cohesive, psychedelic journey typical of early ’68.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s solos are praised (especially on Alligator and the Eleven) though a few reviewers note a stumble at the start of China Cat.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass is described as heavy/muddy yet his work on the Eleven and overall interplay receive positive remarks; occasional over‑emphasis noted.
